card.name: Start of round dose numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 1 or the comma after 1 inside a number that is about to become 100, 1,000 or 1,250. It appears in dose and concentration ranges and limits in drug labels.

modes.label: Digit 1 before 00
modes.description: The digit 1 that begins 100 at the top of a numeric range.

modes.label: Comma after 1
modes.description: The thousands comma right after a leading 1, as in 1,000 or 1,250.

card.writes: It favors the digits that come next in the number rather than other digits; the suppressed digits 3 to 8 point the same way.
card.plain: It fires when a dose number has just started with 1 and is about to continue as 100, 1,000 or 1,250.
